    AI Overview
    Ethan Lovett (played by Nathan Dean, formerly Parsons) is a legacy character on General Hospital returning on April 17, 2026. As the son of Luke Spencer and Holly Sutton, he is a former con artist returning to Port Charles as a more mature, "edgier" character following his father's passing in 2025. 
    Key Details About Ethan Lovett: 
    • Family: He is the son of Holly Sutton and the legendary Luke Spencer. He is the half-brother of Lulu Spencer.
    • Return: Nathan Dean returns to the role after a six-year absence, with his comeback initially spurred by the passing of his on-screen father, Anthony Geary.
    • Character History: Introduced in 2009, Ethan was initially a troublemaker who tried to break into Luke’s bar, the Haunted Star. He has historically had a tumultuous relationship with the town, often acting as a con artist.
    • Actor Update: The role is played by Nathan Dean (formerly known as Nathan Parsons). 
    Ethan returns to a "very different" Port Charles and reconnects with family amidst potential mysterious happenings.

    AI Overview
    Ethan Lovett is the biological son of legendary General Hospital characters Luke Spencer (deceased) and Holly Sutton. Through his father, he is the half-brother of Lucky Spencer and Lulu Spencer. Through his mother, he is the half-brother of Sasha Corbin. 
    Key Family and Connections: 
    • Parents: Luke Spencer (deceased) and Holly Sutton.
    • Half-Siblings: Lucky Spencer, Lulu Spencer, and Sasha Corbin.
    • Adoptive Parents: Frank and Carol Lovett (deceased).
    • Aunt:
      The late Bobbie Spencer (via Luke).
    • Family Role: Ethan was revealed to be a Spencer in 2009, having been conceived during an affair between Luke and Holly.
    • Romantic Links: He had a brief flirtation/romance with Kristina Corinthos-Davis and previously shared a kiss with his half-sister, Lulu, before they knew they were related.
    • Return (2026): Ethan returns to Port Charles with deeper ties to the city's, following the death of his father, Luke. 
    Though initially believing he was a scam artist without family, Ethan was adopted by Frank and Carol Lovett. His parentage was a long-running mystery before being revealed.
